text: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける 正方形Poisson問題から得たSPD行列だけを階層構築へ渡し、平滑化集約AMGのV-cycleを実行します。7²・15²・31²未知数で独立疎行列直接解、解析的な離散正弦モード、連続解への2次収束を分けて検査します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 前提・単位・境界 無次元の単位正方形、一定正係数の−Δu=f、全周同次Dirichlet境界、5点差分です。階層構築には座標・格子幅・nを渡さず、係数行列と暗黙の定数近似核だけを使います。入力は実対称正定値を前提とし、任意の不定値行列を扱うソルバーではありません。 採用した計算法 各行の最大非対角係数に対する相対強度からグラフを作り、貪欲な星型集約と余剰節点の隣接集約への付着で暫定補間Tを作ります。P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T、ω=4/(3ρ̄)、ρ̄はD⁻¹Aの絶対行和上界です。粗演算子はPᵀAP。前後2回のJacobi平滑化と最終小行列の直接解を用います。これは採用した小規模SA変種であり、原著の全構築法や収束定理の再現ではありません。 Algebraic multigrid by smoothed aggregation for second and fourth order elliptic problems · DOI: 10.1007/BF02238511 確認範囲 / review_level: publisher-abstract-and-metadata 独立参照の公式資料：scipy.sparse.linalg.spsolve.html オリジナルコードはMIT。本文・図・固定入力・数値データと第三者資料は、それぞれの利用条件に従います。 LICENSING.md · 利用条件・AI方針 Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless unit square, constant-positive-coefficient −Δu=f, homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries and five-point differences. Hierarchy setup receives no coordinates, mesh width or n; it uses the coefficient matrix and an implicit constant near-null candidate. A real SPD input is assumed; arbitrary indefinite problems are outside scope. Adopted numerical method A graph based on row-relative off-diagonal strength supplies greedy star aggregates; leftover nodes attach to adjacent aggregates. Smooth tentative T via P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T with ω=4/(3ρ̄), where ρ̄ bounds the absolute row sums of D⁻¹A. Coarse operators are PᵀAP. V-cycles use two pre/post Jacobi sweeps and a terminal dense direct solve. This is a small adopted SA variant, not every construction or convergence theorem in the original paper. A randomly permuted matrix is also checked against a direct solution to expose hidden geometric ordering assumptions. A zero cycle budget reports nonconvergence. Verification limits and failures Only three fixed scalar grids are checked. Large coefficient jumps, strong anisotropy, elasticity, arbitrary unstructured meshes, optimal complexity and mesh-independent convergence are not certified. A small residual alone does not prove a small solution error. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
